{{nihongo|'''Ōkawa Shrine'''|大川神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tango Province]].

'''Ōkawa Shrine''' (おおかわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Ōkawa, {{ill|Maizuru|ar|مايزورو (كيوتو)|arz|مايزورو|azb|مایزورو، کیوتو|ba|Майдзуру|ban|Maizuru, Kyōto|ce|Майдзуру|ceb|Maizuru-shi|cs|Maizuru|de|Maizuru|es|Maizuru (Kioto)|fa|مایزورو، کیوتو|fi|Maizuru|fr|Maizuru|gl|Maizuru|id|Maizuru, Kyōto|it|Maizuru|ja|舞鶴市|ko|마이즈루시|lt|Maidzuru|mdf|Майдзуру|mg|Maizuru|my|မအိဇုရုမြို့|mzn|مایزورو، کیوتو|nl|Maizuru|pl|Maizuru|pt|Maizuru|ro|Maizuru|ru|Майдзуру|sv|Maizuru|tg|Маизуру|th|ไมซูรุ|tl|Maizuru|tr|Maizuru|tt|Майдзуру|tum|Maizuru|uk|Майдзуру|ur|مائزورو|uz|Maizuru|vi|Maizuru, Kyōto|war|Maizuru, Kyoto|wuu|舞鹤市|zh|舞鶴市|zh_classical|舞鶴市|zh_min_nan|Maizuru-chhī|zh_yue|舞鶴|qid=Q750573}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}}. Its rank is {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964|lt=Myōjin-tai}}), and former {{ill|Fu-sha|qid=Q134917326|lt=Fusha}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Main deity: {{ill|Ukemochi|Q2280323|qid=Q2280323}}
* Associated deities in the same hall: Kukunochi-no-Kami (wood deity), Kagutsuchi-no-Kami (fire deity), Haniyamahime-no-Kami (earth deity), Kanayamahiko-no-Kami (metal deity), Mizuha-no-Kami (water deity)

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition: "In the Year of the Ox of Emperor Kensō ({{ill|485|Q31001|qid=Q31001}}), the sacred pillars were raised and the shrine was consecrated. In the first year of {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), divine rank was Junior Fifth Rank; in year 13 ({{ill|861|ab|861|af|861|am|861 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|861|ar|861|ary|861|ast|861|avk|861|az|861|azb|۸۶۱ (میلادی)|bcl|861|be|861|be_x_old|861|bg|861|bn|৮৬১|bpy|মারি ৮৬১|br|861|bs|861.|ca|861|cdo|861 nièng|ce|861 шо|ceb|861|ckb|٨٦١|crh|861|cs|861|csb|861|cv|861|cy|861|da|861|de|861|el|861|eml|861|eo|861|es|861|et|861|eu|861|fa|۸۶۱ (میلادی)|fi|861|fo|861|fr|861|fy|861|ga|861|gan|861年|gd|861|gl|861|he|861|hi|861|hr|861.|ht|861 (almanak jilyen)|hu|861|hy|861|id|861|ilo|861|io|861|is|861|it|861|ja|861年|jv|861|ka|861|kaa|861|kk|861 жыл|ko|861년|la|861|lb|861|lij|861|lmo|861|lt|861 m.|lv|861. gads|map_bms|861|mdf|861|mg|861|mhr|861|mk|861|mr|इ.स. ८६१|mrj|861 и|ms|861|mzn|۸۶۱|nah|861|nap|861|nds|861|new|सन् ८६१|nl|861|nn|861|no|861|nrm|861|nso|861|oc|861|or|୮୬୧|os|861-æм аз|pl|861|pnb|861|pt|861|qu|861|ro|861|ru|861 год|rue|861|sa|८६१|scn|861|sd|861ع|se|861|sh|861.|shn|861|si|861|sk|861|sl|861|smn|861|sq|861|sr|861|su|861|sv|861|sw|861|tg|Соли 861|th|พ.ศ. 1404|tk|861|tl|861|tly|861|tr|861|tt|861 ел|uk|861|ur|861ء|uz|861|vec|861|vi|861|vls|861|war|861|wuu|861年|xmf|861|zh|861年|zh_min_nan|861 nî|zh_yue|861年|qid=Q23913}}), it rose to Senior Fifth Rank Lower." In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it was listed as a {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964}}, and it is also a shrine recorded in the {{ill|Rikkokushi|Q1151168|qid=Q1151168}}. In early modern times, it received protection from the Hosokawa lords of the {{ill|Tango-Tanabe Domain|ja|丹後田辺藩|zh|田邊藩 (丹後國)|qid=Q10863423|lt=Tanabe Domain}}.

In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5), it became a gōsha, and in {{ill|1919|Q2157|qid=Q2157}} (Taishō 8), it was ranked as a fusha.

It is known locally as a {{ill|Guardian deities|ja|守護神|qid=Q131278957}} for {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=bountiful harvests}}, sericulture, disease prevention, and safe childbirth, and has many worshippers from {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Hokuriku}} and the Kansai region.

=== Sessha and Massha ===
* Kamado Shrine (Okitsuhiko-no-Kami, Okitsuhime-no-Kami)
* Iso Shrine (Sukunahikona-no-Kami)
* Yakuyoke Shrine (Takehayasusano-no-Mikoto)
* Kōwa Shrine
* Nonomiya Shrine
